purpose: Exact bounded tests of two dynamic-key mechanisms; no solution or historical attribution.

ranked_hypotheses.model: C_i = sigma*P_i + key[i mod p] + d*floor(i/p) mod26. i=0..96, sigma in [1,-1], p=1..12,d=0..25, alphabet AZ or KRYPTOS. Arbitrary p-symbol primer. Global origin0; no shifts, routes, crib movement or key guessing. A global phase origin is absorbed by arbitrary phase keys.
ranked_hypotheses.motivation: K1/K2 demonstrate periodic substitution; progressive cycle offsets are a distinct state mechanism not subject to identical-phase key invariants. Speculative; no claim of artist use.

ranked_hypotheses.model: u_0=0; C_i=sigma*P_i+key[u_i mod p] mod26; u_(i+1)=u_i+1+indicator(C_i in trigger). trigger=AEIOU or BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ; alphabet AZ or KRYPTOS; sigma in [1,-1];p=1..12. Update AFTER the current ciphertext letter. No unknown plaintext trigger, reset, tuning or extra alphabets. Global phase is absorbed by key.
ranked_hypotheses.motivation: The ledger explicitly leaves event-driven keys open beyond identical resets. Published interrupted-key prior art is acknowledged, not claimed novel; these exact cursor rules and their null calibration are the new local test.

ranked_hypotheses.model: Fixed invertible2x2 matrix M and 2-vector b modulo26; C_pair=M*P_pair+b, AZ/KRYPTOS; pair origin0 or1; sole edge symbol passed through unchanged. No transposition or padding.
ranked_hypotheses.motivation: Pair coupling breaks direct monoalphabetic assumptions while preserving length and crib positions. Lower rank because no K4-specific digraph evidence or attested teaching.
ranked_hypotheses.test_design: DEFERRED. Solve affine row constraints on complete EASTNORTHEAST pairs, require determinant coprime26; predict BERLINCLOCK pairs then all24 crib positions/full inverse. Reject if no model satisfies all24. Synthetic known-matrix recovery and mutated holds; same whole-family shuffled null. Odd edge must be explicit. No actual run in this round.

constraint_method: For each configuration derive required base key from each known P/C position; group by cursor phase. Compatibility requires equality in each phase. Record all conflicting models with first one-based witness, occupied/free phases,24-occupied independent equality constraints. No free-key filling or language scoring. sigma=-1 includes true Beaufort; key negation makes separate C=P-K duplicate of sigma=+1.
validation_split: Fit only13 EASTNORTHEAST letters; record training survivors. Predict11 BERLINCLOCK letters only at trained phases, report withheld matches/checkable and uncheckable. Candidate gate: all24 constraints compatible, zero free key phases, all11 holdout letters checkable and matched, exact full97 roundtrip. It remains a crib fit, never independent decoding. All24 were known before design; split is a generalization diagnostic, not independent evidence.
null: 199 independent Random(seed=20261022) histogram-preserving ciphertext shuffles (sequential generator), fixed crib positions/values. Rerun BOTH whole parameter families. Statistic per family=max over configs sum over phase buckets of maximum required-key-symbol frequency. This is best possible same-data crib agreement with free phase keys, upper bound24; compare plus-one >= tail; save every null maximum and compatible count. Include combined-family maximum and its empirical tail, resolution1/200. Correlated/overlapping models not independent trials; no inferential claim beyond conditional exploratory shuffle model or across prior research.
controls: Independent sequential encrypt/decrypt oracle for each family; seeded arbitrary plaintext/key and both alphabets/signs, periods1..12; step updates use independently generated ciphertext. Positive planted model compatibility and full roundtrip; altered observed constraint rejects planted model; progressive d=0 matches ordinary periodic required-key grouping; minimal toy group modal score compared with exhaustive keys. Validate original baseline and existing K1-K3 controls before actual run.

budget.stop: Abort on deadline/candidate cap; atomic RunSnapshot marked incomplete; no scope expansion, no reruns with tuned settings.
